messages:
Priya S.: Quick heads-up: post-launch telemetry shows a spike in error rates on the embedding route and 2 enterprise customers reported degraded throughput. I propose a short stabilization sprint: 3-day focus window, stop greenfield experiments, pick top 6 items (mix of P0/P1 and quick wins). Thoughts?

Diego L.: +1. We should codify what goes into the 6 slots. My suggestion: 1) customer-facing regressions (no workaround) 2) top perf hotspots from traces 3) quick UX bugs that cause retries. Anything else?

Ibrahim H.: From eng: can do 30% squad capacity to fixes for 3 days, but we need strict WIP limits. Also require a minimal reproducer for all P0/P1 before assign. Can we set an owner for each of the 6 and a rollback plan?

Nina P.: Product: agree on owners + rollback. Also want to include two customer-driven asks we committed during launch: (a) zobin corp request for higher embedding concurrency, (b) delta corp asked for a small latency SLA doc. Recommend we label them 'customer-commit' and treat them P2 unless they escalate.

Owen J.: Ops note: I can open a dedicated 'fix' pool on infra and route traffic for affected customers. Need deploy approvals and a canary rollout policy. Suggest canary at 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 20m observation windows.

Priya S.: OK. Let's make a lightweight intake form for items entering the 3-day window: fields = summary, reproduction steps, customer impact, estimated dev effort (hrs), rollback plan, owner. We'll enforce that tickets without that form stay in backlog.

Diego L.: I'll create the rubric for 'quick-win' (<= 16 hours) vs 'standard fix' (<= 5 working days) vs 'investigation'. Also propose a 'no-scope-creep' rule: if a fix grows beyond estimate, re-triage before continuing.

Ibrahim H.: CI gating reminder: any fix touching runtime must have the integration test added and pass on the canary cluster. I'll add a checklist to PR template.

Owen J.: DeployBot: initiating canary for fix/1890 (sha: a1b2c3) on dedicated-fix-pool @ 5%

DeployBot: DeployBot: canary-deploy started for fix/1890 - 5% traffic (sha: a1b2c3).

Nina P.: I'll draft the customer comms for Zobin & Delta and ping legal for the SLA blurb. Also putting together the prioritization matrix: 
- P0: outage/data loss -> immediate interrupt
- P1: significant customer impact -> high priority in 3-day window
- P2: single-customer non-blocking -> customer-commit bucket
- P3: enhancements/polish -> backlog grooming

Priya S.: Great. Action owners: Diego = ticket intake + quick-win rubric; Ibrahim = PR gating + test templates; Owen = canary infra + routing; Nina = customer comms + SLA doc; Priya = run 10m standup at 10:00 PST each day of the window.

Diego L.: I'll tag current backlog items and pick the top 6 by end of today. Also adding a 'hold' label to experiments.

Ibrahim H.: Adding PR checklist items now. Also flagging that the embedding hotspot might be an LRU cache sizing issue; estimate 1.5 engineer-days.

Owen J.: Canary green at 25% for 30m with stable metrics. Promoting to 100%.

DeployBot: DeployBot: canary promoted to 25% for fix/1890 (sha: a1b2c3).

Priya S.: Excellent. Two process notes: 1) limit concurrent bug WIP to 8 across squads, 2) require a customer-facing note for any public-impact fix within 4 hours of deployment.

Nina P.: Draft comms posted in #customer-updates for review. Please comment.

Diego L.: Quick question: do we allow swap-ins from other squads if a ticket stalls? I propose yes but only after re-triage and handoff doc.

Ibrahim H.: Agreed. Handoff doc = minimal reproducer + current hypothesis + attempted fixes.

Priya S.: Thanks all. We'll run the 3-day stabilization sprint starting tomorrow 09:00 PST. I'll create the intake board and lock experiments. See you at 10:00 standups. :white_check_mark:
